capture_mechanism: window.fetch wrapped in the page before each turn; request URL, status, body length and phrase occurrence positions recorded; no header, key or full body committed

providers.note: 413 was a request the broker refused as too large; the retry (smaller request) answered 200. The 413 body was still captured and checked.
The provider was reached and refused with its free-models-per-day limit; the fallback then answered on Groq. No OpenRouter completion is claimed.

run_1_before_delete.when: fresh conversation asked for the phrase

run_1_after_delete.when: another fresh conversation asked for the phrase

run_2_after_delete_with_fix.when: fresh conversation asked for the spare key

conversation_b_isolation.evidence: every request in run 2 was a brand-new conversation with no other chat's material; the labelled “RESEARCH FROM OTHER CHATS” block appeared only in the pre-fix run, and then only because it quoted the user's own question (see cross-chat-indicator.json). After the fix no request in run 2 contained that block.
conversation_b_isolation.related_but_unused: the earlier chats were listed in “RELATED CHATS (not authorized)” and in the activity as “Related, not used (not linked)” — visible, not injected

redaction: Bodies are not stored. Only status, length, occurrence counts and short labelled excerpts are recorded.
